reason: A puts a labelled, operable artifact in the first screen at every width, recomposes it for the phone so feedback lands where you tapped, and gives the lab manager a working view of their own, with every state staying consistent across sections. B has the stronger 1440 hero composition and some of the best lines, but its phone layout pushes the result below the fold and its example label is late. A cleaner 1440 hero in A or a phone recomposition in B would narrow the gap.
